assets.caption: FIGURE 1    EXAMPLE OF PRESSURE CONTROL AND RELIEF PROTECTION
assets.description: P&ID schematic showing a pipeline segment with a pressure control valve (PIC), a pressure relief alarm (PRA) with high (H) set point, and a pressure safety valve (PSV) in series. Flow direction labelled from Source to Pipeline.

assets.caption: FIGURE 2    EXAMPLE OF PRESSURE CONTROL AND IPF PROTECTION
assets.description: P&ID schematic showing a pipeline with a PIC pressure controller and PRA (H) alarm, a solenoid valve within an IPF dashed boundary box, and an IPF system block containing a voting system, pressure sensors, and manifold. Flow direction labelled from source to pipeline.
